title: SLO Signal Correlation and Notification Synthesis Guide
author: Arielle Chen
summary: Defines patterns and procedures to synthesize correlated SLO signals into compact notifications that reduce alert fatigue and accelerate mitigation for model-serving fleets.
scope: Applies to hosted API, Dedicated, and Private model-serving fleets. Covers signal ingestion, correlation rules, synthesized notifications, routing, automated pre-actions, and evidence attachment for incident review.
goals: Reduce noisy metric-level alerts by 50%, provide top-3 correlated signals in the first page, and make error-budget mitigations reproducible and auditable.
key_definitions: Primary SLO: customer-visible objective. Evidence signals: raw metrics like 5xx rate, p99 latency, queue length, GPU load. Signal group: correlated signals indicating the same root cause. Synthesized notification: aggregated alert payload including signal groups, severity, playbook link, and actions.
signal_taxonomy: Latency group (p95/p99, KV cache miss ratio); Error group (5xx, model serialization failures); Capacity group (queue depth, GPU util, OOMs); Degradation group (quality regressions); Control plane group (scheduler/ autoscaler failures).
correlation_strategy: Windowed co-occurrence: correlate signals exceeding thresholds within a 3-10 minute overlap. Use causal heuristics to prefer leading indicators. Compute weighted correlation scores where weights come from historical RCA relevance. Suppress underlying metric alerts while a synthesized incident is active.
threshold_examples: Error-group trigger: 5xx > 0.1% absolute and >=3x baseline for 5m (weight 3). Latency trigger: p99 > 350ms and p95 > 120ms for 5m (weight 2). Capacity trigger: GPU util > 92% or queue depth > 850 for 3m (weight 4). Correlation score >=8 => P1; 5-7 => P2; 3-4 => P3; <3 => log-only.
notification_payload: Payload fields: title, 1-line summary, signal groups with top metrics and values, suggested playbook link, automated actions taken (if any), evidence links (traces, flamegraphs, last-deploy id), recommended first actions.
routing: Route by severity and group: P1 -> primary model-serving on-call + eng-sre pager; P2 -> primary on-call + team Slack; P3 -> email digest + triage channel. Include tenant hints for multi-tenant pages. Escalate P1 after 8 minutes, P2 after 20.
preactions_and_constraints: Allowed pre-actions for configured services: engage autoscaler (with cooldown), apply traffic fallback to compatible variant, temporary emergency token-priority grants. Pre-actions must be idempotent and reversible; every automated action must include a rollback link. Disallow automated canary rollbacks if canary health is unknown.
error_budget_integration: Attach remaining 30d rolling error budget and burn-rate to the synthesized notification. If remaining budget <20% and burn-rate >3x, suggest aggressive conservation: shed non-critical tenants, disable non-essential batch jobs.
incident_review_and_evidence: Attach correlation graph, scoring timeline, automated actions and timestamps, and saved query results to post-incident review. Every P1 must include a reproducible minimal repro or explanation why repro is infeasible. Reviewers must validate the correlation rule and suppression timing.
tooling_integrations: Metrics path: Prometheus -> Thanos -> SLO pipeline. Correlation engine: stream-based rules engine (e.g., Flink) that enriches events. Notification path: Alertmanager -> synthesizer -> PagerDuty/Slack. Tracing: Jaeger/Tempo attachments. Evidence archive: S3 with 90d retention for incidents.
example_payload: Human-readable example: title: 'synth-[P1] model-serving p99+5xx us-west-2'; severity: P1; score: 12; signal_groups: latency p99 672ms, errors 5xx 0.27%, capacity GPU util 96%; actions_taken: autoscaler scale_out (id), fallback routed 20% to variant-small; playbook link to canonical runbook.
rollout_and_verification: Dry-run 2 weeks in alert-only mode; canary region and low-risk tenant for 72 hours; full rollout after 3 successful canaries. Verify pager volume reduction and MTTR improvements for 30 days; roll back if pager volume reduction <30% or MTTR increases >15%.
maintenance_and_governance: Quarterly tuning by the SRE telemetry working group. Label each correlation rule with owner, purpose, last-tuned date, and runbook. Annual audit sampling 50 synthesized notifications with target >85% alignment between top-3 signals and root cause.
ownership_contacts: Correlation engine: eng-sre/telemetry (Marcus O'Reilly). Notification synthesizer: eng-platform/alerts (Priya Natarajan). Evidence retention: eng-infra (Diego Alvarez).
appendix_queries: PromQL p99 example: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)). Saved view example: 'synth-correlation-window-10m-us-west-2'.
changelog: 2026-11-02: initial draft and prototype rules. 2026-12-10: weight tuning after us-east-1 canary reduced false positives by 34%. 2027-01-15: publish with automated pre-action templates and rollback links.
conclusion: Synthesized notifications that surface correlated signals and couple them to safe automated actions and error-budget guidance reduce cognitive load and improve consistency of mitigation. Follow rollout, governance, and evidence policies in this guide.
